title: SPADE-nf pipeline parameters
description: ERCC spike-in aware RNA-seq differential expression and enrichment with SPADE

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Count matrix, sample metadata and where to save results.

counts.description: Raw gene count matrix (tab-delimited): geneID and/or geneSymbol, optional bioType and annotationLevel, then one column per sample. Rows whose symbol starts with ERCC- are spike-ins.
counts.help_text: Same format as the SPADE Shiny app (e.g. RSEM gene counts). Required unless --cab_internal with --input or --automapper_dir.

meta.description: Sample metadata (tab-delimited) with ID, NEWNAME and GROUP columns; optional COLOR, BATCH, GENDER, SHAPE.
meta.help_text: ID must match the count-matrix column names. Only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' are allowed in ID, NEWNAME and GROUP. BATCH (or GENDER) with more than one level is added to the limma design.

comparisons.description: Comparison list, one Exp_vs_Ctl per line (both groups from GROUP). All pairs of groups if omitted.
comparisons.help_text: log2FC is Exp relative to Ctl. Limma contrast formulas such as name=(A-B) are also accepted.

species.description: Species of the count matrix; checked against gene IDs/symbols and used to pick MSigDB human or mouse gene sets.
species.help_text: Use other for any other species; fgsea then needs --custom_gmt.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

prefix.description: Prefix for output file names [default: SPADE; CAB internal: the SRM name or mergedSRMs_<n>].

differential_expression_options.title: Differential expression options
differential_expression_options.description: Normalization and filtering for limma-voom (changing these re-runs SPADE_DE).

ercc.description: Use ERCC spike-in normalization when the count matrix has ERCC- rows. Without ERCC- rows (or with too few ERCC reads) the run uses library-size (TMM) normalization and says so in the log and report.

filter_noncoding.description: Keep only protein-coding genes (bioType) with annotationLevel <= 3, when those columns exist. Set false to include non-coding genes.

cutoff_count.description: Raw count cutoff for low-expression filtering; 0 = automatic (median library size / 10 million, i.e. CPM 0.1).

cutoff_cpm.description: CPM cutoff for low-expression filtering; 0 = automatic, -1 = no filtering. Takes precedence over --cutoff_count.

report_options.title: Report options
report_options.description: DEG cutoffs, plots and report header (changing these re-runs SPADE_REPORT only).

cutoff_fdr.description: FDR cutoff to define DEGs (top DEGs use FDR only).

topn_deg.description: Number of top up- and down-regulated DEGs labelled in plots and shown in heatmaps.

num_gene_pca.description: Number of most variable genes used for PCA.

volcano.description: Also save one volcano plot PDF per comparison.

project_name.description: Project name shown in the report header.

pi_name.description: PI name shown in the report header.

project_lead.description: Project lead(s) shown in the report header.

lead_analysts.description: Analyst(s) shown in the report header.

group_lead.description: Group lead shown in the CAB report header.

contact_email.description: Contact e-mail shown in the report header.

department.description: Department shown in the report header.

task_id.description: Task ID shown in the report header.

start_date.description: Project start date shown in the report header.

enrichment_options.title: Enrichment options
enrichment_options.description: fgsea with MSigDB gene sets and optional Enrichr.

run_fgsea.description: Run fgsea for every comparison and gene set.

fgsea_gene_sets.description: Comma-separated gene sets: 'default' (GO MF/BP/CC, cell type, canonical pathways, CGP, Hallmark, plus oncogenic signatures (human) or tumor phenotype (mouse)), names from assets/msigdb_gene_sets.csv, or MSigDB file stems such as c2.cp.reactome.

fgsea_rank_metric.description: Gene ranking for fgsea: t statistic, sign(log2FC)*-log10(P) or log2FC.

fgsea_pval_cutoff.description: Keep pathways (fgsea) with P below this value.

fgsea_top_n.description: Pathways/terms per enrichment plot (fgsea and Enrichr).

custom_gmt.description: Comma-separated GMT files (gene symbols) to test in addition to MSigDB; required for --species other.

msigdb_version.description: MSigDB release of the GMT files.

msigdb_dir.description: Local directory with MSigDB GMT files (<stem>.v<version>.<Hs|Mm>.symbols.gmt), for compute environments without internet.

run_enrichr.description: Run Enrichr (web API; needs outbound internet from compute nodes).

enrichr_dbs.description: 'standard' (newest Hallmark, GO BP/MF/CC, KEGG, Reactome libraries) or comma-separated Enrichr library names.

enrichr_rank_metric.description: Gene ranking used to pick Enrichr input genes.

cab_internal_options.title: CAB internal options
cab_internal_options.description: St. Jude CAB only: AutoMapper inputs, multi-SRM merge and CAB report branding.

cab_internal.description: CAB internal mode: allows the options below and uses the CAB report branding (logo, wiki links).

input.description: CSV with one row per AutoMapper SRM: srm, counts, and optional report, tpm, fpkm. Several rows are merged.

automapper_dir.description: AutoMapper output directory; files are found as <dir>/<SRM>/<SRM>_RSEM_count.txt and <SRM>*.report.

srm.description: SRM name(s) for --automapper_dir; join several with '_' to merge them (e.g. SRM1_SRM2).

mapping_report.description: AutoMapper <SRM>.report file for the mapping QC tables.

mapping_qc.description: Overall mapping QC call shown in the CAB report overview (e.g. good).

software_options.title: Software options
software_options.description: Container with R, Bioconductor and the SPADE function files.

spade_version.description: SPADE release in the container (shown in the report).

spade_container.description: Container image with R, Bioconductor and SPADE in /opt/spade.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
